Actually, let me reconsider. The tuple version takes 2.0s. Let me try the int-key version properly:

```python
def v4(nst, ip, dst, w, srcs):
    dist=[INF]*nst
    heap=[]
    for s in srcs:
        dist[s]=0
        heap.append(s)          # key = 0<<SH | s = s
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    push=heapq.heappush; pop=heapq.heappop
    while heap:
        key = pop(heap)
        u = key & MASK
        d = dist[u]
        if (key >> SH) != d: continue
        for j in range(ip[u], ip[u+1]):
            v = dst[j]
            nd = d + w[j]
            if nd < dist[v]:
                dist[v]=nd
                push(heap, (nd<<SH) | v)
    return dist
```

import sys, json, time, heapq
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, algo, topo
prof = json.load(open('/tmp/bigprof.json'))
fab = json.load(open('/tmp/bigfab.json'))
cal = para.calibrate(prof)
F = topo.Fabric(fab)
H,_ = para.hop_tables(cal['upper_ps'], prof['jitter_ps'])
F.build_edges(H)
ip,dst,w,_k = F.csr(0)
srcs = F.anchor_states.tolist()
nst = F.nstates
INF = topo.INF
SH = 19; MASK=(1<<SH)-1

def v1(nst, ip, dst, w, srcs):
    dist=[INF]*nst; heap=[]
    for s in srcs: dist[s]=0; heap.append((0,s))
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    push=heapq.heappush; pop=heapq.heappop; cnt=0; imp=0
    while heap:
        d,u = pop(heap)
        if d > dist[u]: continue
        cnt+=1
        for j in range(ip[u], ip[u+1]):
            v = dst[j]
            nd = d + w[j]
            if nd < dist[v]:
                dist[v]=nd; imp+=1; push(heap,(nd,v))
    return dist, cnt, imp

def v4(nst, ip, dst, w, srcs):
    dist=[INF]*nst; heap=[]
    for s in srcs: dist[s]=0; heap.append(s)
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    push=heapq.heappush; pop=heapq.heappop; cnt=0; imp=0
    while heap:
        key = pop(heap)
        u = key & MASK
        d = dist[u]
        if (key >> SH) != d: continue
        cnt+=1
        for j in range(ip[u], ip[u+1]):
            v = dst[j]
            nd = d + w[j]
            if nd < dist[v]:
                dist[v]=nd; imp+=1; push(heap, (nd<<SH) | v)
    return dist, cnt, imp

for name, fn in (('v1',v1),('v4',v4)):
    t0=time.time(); d,c,i=fn(nst,ip,dst,w,srcs); print(name, round(time.time()-t0,3), 'settled', c, 'impr', i, d[:2])
